title: SMP Holiday in the Barracks

sections.heading: Holidays In The Barracks
sections.markdown:
Enjoy good food, good company, and relax at the Main Side Rec Center. A holiday gift bag will be given to each service member in attendance. This is always a fun event which includes a great holiday meal!

**Date:** December 17

**Time:** 11 AM - 2 PM

**Location:** Main Side Rec Center 206 Nicholas Rd., Quantico, VA 22134

**[REGISTER ON EVENTBRITE](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/1999284054426?aff=oddtdtcreator)**

MUST BE A SINGLE MARINE BETWEEN THE AGES OF 18-25 OR A GEO BACHELOR. NOT OPEN TO CIVILIANS.

We've got wheels! Transportation to the MSRC provided to Single Service Members and geo-bachelors associated with the SMP. Seating limited; first come, first served.

For more information or to arrange pick-up, call 703.432.0363 or Email: MCCSQUANTICOSMP@USMC-MCCS.ORG

Volunteer Opportunity
Duties: Assist with gift bag distribution, and other duties needed at the Holiday in the Barracks event.
If your interested in volunteering for this event, please specify when registering.
